headline: Back in profit versus a year ago, but below last quarter
summary_short: PTT Global Chemical reported EPS of ฿2.03 versus a loss of ฿0.73 a year ago, and down 18.7% q/q from ฿2.50.
summary_long: EPS is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed. Earlier coverage showed Q2 2026 net profit of ฿12.2B and adjusted EBITDA of ฿26.9B, but no Q3 release was found.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
